content: Arebbi d řgens nnes Israil
Qqareɣ tidett di Lmasiḥ, war ssxarriqeɣ ca, uca tanefsect inu tcehhed dayi s Arruḥ Iqeddsen,
belli ɣari acḍan imɣar d řeḥriq war ittbeddi deg wuř inu.
Tuɣa ttẓaǧiɣ meɛlik ufiɣ ttwaḥarrmeɣ di mummu inu x Lmasiḥ s ict nneɛřet di ṭṭweɛ n wawmaten inu, řaǧ inu zi jjihet n weysum n arrimet.
arrawen n Israil, inni ittwaqebřen d mmis. Ɣarsen i yeǧa uɛuǧi, řɛuhud, Ccariɛa, tasexxart i iǧan di Zzawect Iqeddsen i ɣares dd-iqqnen, lwuɛud d řejdud.
Zzaysen i dd-iban Lmasiḥ x webrid n weysum n arrimet wenni d AREBBI x marra. I Netta i ɣa yiři marra asemɣar d marra lbaraka i řebda qaɛ. Amin!
Maca war iǧi ařami awař n AREBBI war yiwiḍ, minzi marra inni zi Israil war ǧin ca d Israil.
Uca uřa d marra nitni war ǧin ca d tarwa n Ibrahim, minzi nitni zi zzariɛet n Ibrahim, minzi ittwanna: “Di Isḥaq ad ac řaɣan zzariɛet.”
Man aya war ixs ad yini aqa tarwa ɛlaḥṣab jjadira n arrimet aqa-ten d tarwa n AREBBI, maca tarwa n lwaɛd ad ttwaḥesben d zzariɛet.
Minzi awař n lwaɛd d wa:
“Ɣar řweqt-a ad dd-aseɣ uca ad ɣares yiři ɣar Sara mmis!”
Man aya war iǧi waha di tmesřact n Sara, maca uřa di tmesřact n Rifqa, umi tmun ak-d uyenni n bnadem nni, jedditeɣ Isḥaq,

tuɣa tizzar tettwassen řixḍaret n AREBBI umi tuɣa ɛad war dd-xřiqen iḥenjiren nnes, war zemmaren ad ggen ɛad řxar niɣ řɣar, ḥima war tᵉttiři tmesřact deg webrid n řexdayem, maca deg webrid n wenni ittřaɣan.
Maɣar ittwanna i Rifqa:
“Aqa ameqqran ad isexxar i umeẓyan!”,
am mammec tura:
“Yaɛqub i xseɣ, maca carheɣ Isu.”
Min ɣa nini xenni? Ma iqedd ad yiři ɣar AREBBI min war iseggden? Ɛemmarṣ!
Xzar, Netta inna ɛawed i Musa:
“Ad areḥmeɣ wi xseɣ ad areḥmeɣ, uca ad ḥinneɣ x wi xseɣ ad ḥinneɣ.”
Xenni tamesřact war teqqim ca ɣar wi ittexsen uřa ɣar wi ittazzřen, maca ɣar AREBBI wenni yareḥḥmen.
Minzi ɛlaḥsab Tira Iqeddsen inna Netta i firɛun:
“Aqa i man aya ssnekkareɣ-dd cek, ḥima ad zzayek ssecneɣ jjehd inu, uca ad ittwabarreḥ Isem inu di marra ddunect.”
Xenni Netta ad yarḥem wi ixs, uca ad isseqseḥ wi ixs.
Iwa, ad taɣ ad tinid: Mayemmi ittcetca ɛad, minzi wi ɣa immɛařan ak-d min ixs Netta?
Maca min teɛnid cek, a bnadem, wenni ittqacaḥen AREBBI? Ma min ittwaggen izemmar ad ini i wenni t iggin: “Mayemmi d ayi teggid ammu?”
Ma war iǧi ɣar bu-třaxt ṣṣulṭa x třaxt ḥima ad igg zeg ict n řɛejnet ict n řqecɛet i lkarama u wenneɣni i ubehdeř?
Maɣar AREBBI, wenni tuɣa ixs ad isscen aɣḍab nnes d jjehd nnes, issiweḍ lɣaḍab nnes s waṭṭas n ttasiɛ n řxaḍar x řeqcuɛ n weɣḍab inni ittwasswejden marra i uhellek,
uca ifarɣ tayri nnes x řeqcuɛ n arreḥmet inni izwar issewjed i-ten i uɛuǧi i AREBBI!
Maɣar neccin d inni ittwařaɣan, war iǧi zeg Wudayen waha, maca ɛawed zi řegnus.
Am mammec ittwanna ɛawed di Ḥuciɛa:
“Ad semmiɣ i yinni war iǧin d řgens inu ‘Řgens inu!’, uca i yinni war iǧin d amɛizz d ‘Amɛizz!’”
Ad yiři deg wemcan mani d asen ittwařaɣa:
‘War iǧi d řgens inu!’,
belli dinni ad asen řaɣan:
‘Arrawen n AREBBI iddaren!’
Maca Icaɛya ibarreḥ zi jjihet n ayt n Israil:
“Mařa tuɣa řqedd n ayt n Israil anect n ijdi n řebḥar, mɣir min i ɣa iqqimen ad injem.”
“Tamesřact tbedd nican u ad tᵉttwaqfeř, SIDI ad tt igg x temmurt.”
Am mammec izwar Icaɛya inna:
“Maɛlik SIDI n řɛeskarat war d aneɣ ijji inni iqqimen ddaren, iři nedweř am Sadum u narwes di Ɛamurra.”
Min ɣa nini xenni? Ma xenni řegnus inni war yarezzun tasegda, aqa ksin tasegda? Iwa, maca tasegda tenni s l’iman.
Maca Israil nni iḍeffaren Ccariɛa n tsegda, war yiwiḍ ca ɣar Ccariɛa n tsegda.
Mayemmi? Minzi tasegda nni war teǧi ca zi l’iman maca zi řexdayem n Ccariɛa, minzi nitni nderfen deg Weẓru n unedref,
am mammec tura:
“Aqa ad ggeɣ di Ṣihyun Aẓru i unedref d Weẓru i uneqrad. Marra wi zzayes i ɣa yamnen, war ittseḍḥa.”
